description: MUST-FAIL: stream truncated before the terminal 'done' chunk. The transport-delivered domain does not produce a complete pre-image: the final delta has no 'done' marker. A conforming implementation MUST signal an error (stream_incomplete) rather than digest a partial object. Without this rejection, two verifiers with different truncation points would compute different digests for the same source stream — and neither mismatch would be attributable to a declared transform. The failure mode is not the inability to parse JSON (the partial bytes may be valid JSON by accident); it is that the declared 'stream-reassemble' transform requires a terminal chunk to bound the pre-image, and none is present.

domain_transforms.description: Reassemble SSE delta chunks into a single JSON object. Requires a terminal chunk with 'done: true'.

note: The source array ends without a terminal chunk (no 'done: true'). The stream-reassemble transform MUST raise stream_incomplete. A partial JSON string like '{"finish_reason":...' may happen to be valid JSON — the guard is the missing terminal marker, not a JSON parse error.
